gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of all navigation views available in the Zulip application so that I can understand the different sections I can navigate to.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of navigation views, each with a unique identifier, title, and associated URL.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to add a new navigation view to the application so that users can access a new feature directly from the navigation menu.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful addition of the navigation view and return the details of the newly created view.

gold.user: As a user, I want to edit an existing navigation view to update its title or URL so that it reflects the latest changes in the application.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate success and return the updated details of the navigation view.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to remove a navigation view that is no longer needed so that the navigation menu remains clean and relevant for users.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful deletion of the navigation view and ensure that it is no longer accessible.
